policy: Exclude named compounds with a verified label warning for increased riluzole exposure under this conservative research screen. A label warning does not establish an adverse event or an absolute contraindication.

Compound::DB12243.name: edaravone
Compound::DB12243.finding: Comparator with documented concomitant riluzole in the ALS trial (section 14); the label does not expect clinically significant CYP1A2 inhibition at recommended doses (12.3).
Compound::DB12243.remaining_risks: Hypersensitivity and sulfite reactions, including asthmatic episodes (5.1–5.2). Allergy history is unknown. Evidence is specific to labeled use, not hypothetical local delivery.

regulatory_status.value: Health Canada authorized RADICAVA for ALS; existing indication comparator

Compound::DB01043.name: memantine
Compound::DB01043.finding: Section 12.3 reports minimal CYP1A2 inhibition in vitro. This supports only a narrow interaction review.
Compound::DB01043.remaining_risks: Renal function, tolerability and safety under local delivery unknown.
Compound::DB01043.trial: MND-SMART found little or no effect on functional decline at the tested dose.

chart_exclusions.name: gabapentin
chart_exclusions.reason: Conservative exclusion for reduced respiratory reserve in this case. Section 5.8 warns of respiratory depression with underlying respiratory impairment; this is a monitoring warning, not an absolute contraindication.
